title: AI How-To Video Maker for Product Demos | AIVideosUGC
description: AI how-to video maker: turn one product photo into a clear demo for Shorts and ads without filming a presenter. Choose 9:16 or 16:9 for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.
h1: AI How-To Video Maker for a Task You Can Follow
lead: Pick a product how-to scene and add one photo, so the clip shows the task from setup to the result.
steps_h2: Make a Product Demo Video From a Photo in 3 Steps
steps_lead: One product photo, a short line about the task, then a file you can post.

steps.d: Show the whole product, including the part that does the work. Keep every edge inside the frame.
Name the task and one change a shopper should see. Then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the file and add step labels in your editor. Post it once the action matches the real product.

faq.q: What is an AI how-to video template?
faq.a: A ready scene that shows one product task from setup to result. You add a photo of your item, and the clip lets a shopper watch the job.

faq.q: How do I make the how-to clip?
faq.a: Upload the photo, name the task and one visible change, pick a size and a length, then download the file.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of filming a presenter?
faq.a: The demonstration is built from the photo you already have. You do not book a presenter, a studio day, or a reshoot to explain one task.
Sellers, support teams, and agencies that need a clear how-to for a listing, a Short, or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Pick a task scene, upload one clear photo, and add a short line about the action. Check the working part before you post.
A sharp photo of the whole product, with the working part visible and no important edge cut off.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: This template is set up for 9:16 and 16:9. The product also offers 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Will the file speak the instructions?
faq.a: No. The template makes the picture. Add narration, captions, or step labels in your editor after download.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your listings and paid ads. You are responsible for the instructions and any claim. If a person appears, that person is an AI performer, not a customer.

steps.sourceHint: Show the full tool and the surface it works on.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. Switch on this white handheld steamer beside a blue shirt, then press the fabric in one steady pass. Close side framing with one short push-in. Soft window light. End with the steamer beside the smooth panel of blue fabric.
